proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s A B C D X Y hA hB hC hD hX hY hAB hCD hXA hXB hYC hYD hang
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have key : ∀ U W Z : P, U ∈ s → W ∈ s → Z ∈ s → U ≠ W → Z ≠ U → Z ≠ W → dist U W = 2 * s.radius * Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle U Z W) := by
    intro U W Z hU hW hZ hUW hZU hZW
    have h := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.dist_div_sin_oangle_eq_two_mul_radius hU hZ hW hZU.symm hUW hZW
    rw [← Real.Angle.sin_toReal, Real.abs_sin_eq_sin_abs_of_abs_le_pi (Real.Angle.abs_toReal_le_pi _), ← EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_abs_oangle_toReal hZU.symm hZW.symm] at h
    by_cases h0 : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle U Z W) = 0
    · rw [h0, div_zero] at h
      have hr : s.radius = 0 := by linarith
      have h1 : dist U s.center = 0 := by rw [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hU, hr]
      have h2 : dist W s.center = 0 := by rw [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hW, hr]
      exact absurd ((dist_eq_zero.mp h1).trans (dist_eq_zero.mp h2).symm) hUW
    · exact (div_eq_iff h0).mp h
  rw [key A B X hA hB hX hAB hXA hXB, key C D Y hC hD hY hCD hYC hYD, hang]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B C D X Y : P), A ∈ s → B ∈ s → C ∈ s → D ∈ s → X ∈ s → Y ∈ s → A ≠ B → C ≠ D → X ≠ A → X ≠ B → Y ≠ C → Y ≠ D → EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B = EuclideanGeometry.angle C Y D → dist A B = dist C D
